title: Vietnam veteran's survivor guilt

tellings.quote: there was one guy when I was a very young doctor who was in Vietnam and they were in a firefight and

plain: Greg Rogers, a former NASA doctor, tells Michels about a man he treated when he was a very young doctor. The man had been in a firefight in Vietnam and came home weighed down by guilt that he had lived when others did not. Rogers passes on what the patient told him and uses the story to talk about how heavy experiences mark the people who live through them.
